subject: english
question:
**Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.**

Following in the footsteps of France, Italy has ______ (1) ______ a new tax to be ______ (2) ______ on large tech companies, a move that is likely to put more strain on the country's relations with the USA. The Italian parliament has approved a 3% digital tax on some digital revenue of technology companies that make over $831 million in global revenue, including at least $6 million in Italy. The tax ______ (3) ______ similar to the one France implemented earlier this year, which has attracted ______ (4) ______ criticism from the USA. According to a report in The Epoch Times, dozens of countries are working on proposals to change corporate tax schemes to ______ (5) ______ money from tech firms that have users across the world, such as Facebook and Google's parent company Alphabet.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** "is."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject **"tax" **is singular, so the verb should also be singular **("is")**.
 
• **"Are"** and **"were"** are both plural verbs, which do not agree with the singular subject.
 
• **"Have"** is a present perfect verb, which is not appropriate for this sentence structure.
 
• Using** "is"** maintains subject-verb agreement and creates a grammatically correct sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage:**

Following in the footsteps of France, Italy has ______ (1) ______ a new tax to be ______ (2) ______ on large tech companies, a move that is likely to put more strain on the country's relations with the USA. The Italian parliament has approved a 3% digital tax on some digital revenue of technology companies that make over $831 million in global revenue, including at least $6 million in Italy. The tax **is**__ similar to the one France implemented earlier this year, which has attracted ______ (4) ______ criticism from the USA. According to a report in The Epoch Times, dozens of countries are working on proposals to change corporate tax schemes to ______ (5) ______ money from tech firms that have users across the world, such as Facebook and Google's parent company Alphabet.
